neighbours.label: a naming phrase introducing a term: 'known as', 'so-called', 'called' (a drug called X)
fire: The patients received a treatment known as deep brain stimulation.
Scientists found a molecule known as a kinase in the cells.
These are so-called dark matter particles.
The procedure uses a device called a stent to open arteries.
Engineers built a structure known as a caisson below the river.
The bacteria produce a so-called biofilm on the surface.
A region of the brain called the hippocampus stores memories.
Farmers use a method known as crop rotation.
quiet: The patients received a treatment at the new clinic.
Scientists found a molecule that is well known to chemists.
These are small dark matter particles.
The surgeon called the patient's family after the procedure.
Engineers built a structure below the river as a test.
The bacteria produce a thin film on the surface.
A region of the brain that stores memories was damaged.
Farmers rotate their crops as the seasons change.
